authors: Ad van der Hoeven,Corniel Nobel,Erik Ammerlaan,Fons Sonnemans,Jack Kester,Hanif Hafez Nezami,Laura Kramer,Patrick Evers,Renzo Baasdam,Vincent Lesierse,Wilko Frieke,Wesley Baartman
description:
Qowaiv is a (Single) Value Object library. It aims to model reusable (Single)
Value Objects that can be used in a wide variety of modeling scenarios, both
inside and outside a Domain-driven context.
